# NotionStack

> > NotionStack is the ultimate resource hub for discovering, learning, and mastering Notion templates, courses, tools, and creators.

NotionStack aggregates the best Notion templates, educational courses, complementary tools, and creator profiles in one centralized marketplace. The platform serves as a discovery engine for productivity systems, second brains, and specialized templates across industries like startups, product management, and property hosting.

## Key Topics

- Notion templates
- Productivity systems
- Second brain
- Task management
- Goal tracking
- Project management
- Life planning
- Habit tracking
- PARA methodology
- Notion integrations
- Notion courses
- Template marketplace
- Notion creators
- Dashboard design
- Notion formulas

## Core Resources

- [The Ultimate Notion Resource - NotionStack](https://notionstack.so): NotionStack homepage showcasing templates, courses, guides, and tools for Notion productivity.

- [Notion Tools - NotionStack](https://notionstack.so/tools): Directory of complementary tools and integrations that extend Notion's functionality.
- [Notion Courses & Guides - NotionStack](https://notionstack.so/courses): Handpicked Notion courses and guides covering formulas, templates, and skill development.

## Popular Productivity Templates

- [Ultimate Second Brain: Capture and Organize Everything in Notion](https://notionstack.so/templates/ultimate-second-brain): Easlo's all-in-one Notion system using PARA methodology for knowledge and task organization.
- [Super Life: The Ultimate Life Planner for Notion](https://notionstack.so/templates/super-life): Comprehensive life planner template for goal tracking, finances, habits, and wellness.
- [Obsidian Life OS: A Powerful Productivity System for Notion](https://notionstack.so/templates/obsidian-life-os): Deepak Yadav's unified Notion system for life organization, goals, and personal planning.
- [Stoic Life OS: Cultivate a Stoic Mindset](https://notionstack.so/templates/stoic-life-os): Pascio's customizable Notion system for stoic productivity, time management, and life planning.
